messages:
zara.sre: RCA for the 06/20 model-serving hiccup is published: https://docs.redwood/inference/postmortems/1876543210-model-serving-hiccup. TL;DR: cache compaction race + a batching metric regression caused elevated p95s for ~26 minutes; mitigation was an emergency config revert.
zara.sre: I put a 3-item "Immediate Fixes" checklist and an "Owners" table at the bottom. Please pick items or shout if you can't.
postmortem-bot: New doc snapshot created by zara.sre: https://docs.redwood/inference/postmortems/1876543210-model-serving-hiccup :robot_face:
liam.platform: Can someone add the exact reverted commit id and the revert PR link? need for audits.
zara.sre: Added commit `f7c4b9d` and revert PR link in Appendix A.
olga.prod: I'll own customer comms and the exec blurb. Drafting outreach now, ETA tomorrow 10:00 PT.
dan.eng: I'll take the perf-test addition to staging to cover cache-compaction scenarios. Will drop a short test and link it in the doc by Wed COB.
zara.sre: Immediate action list (copied here):
1) Insert full revert diff + commit hash in RCA  owner: @zara.sre  due: today EOD
2) Customer comms draft + approval  owner: @olga.prod  due: tomorrow 10:00 PT
3) Add cache-compaction perf test to staging + CI gate  owner: @dan.eng  due: Wed COB
4) Alert tuning: widen cache stall alert window 15s -> 35s  owner: @liam.platform  due: tomorrow 14:00 PT
zara.sre: Proposing a short follow-up sync next week to close actions. Options: Tue 11:00 PT or Fri 15:00 PT. React with :thumbsup: for preferred slot.
liam.platform: Tue 11:00 PT works for me.
olga.prod: Fri 15:00 PT preferred (customer meetings on Tue morning).
dan.eng: I can do Tue 11:00 but prefer Fri 15:00 to finish the perf test.
zara.sre: Locking Fri 15:00 PT then. Calendar invite will follow. Agenda: quick recap, action updates, decision on alert thresholds, finalize comms.
postmortem-bot: Calendar invite created: "Follow-up: 06/20 model-serving hiccup RCA" Fri 15:00 PT  https://calendar.redwood/ev/1876543210-followup
liam.platform: I'll prepare a short cost vs reliability note on the alert threshold change and drop it in the doc before the meeting.
zara.sre: Thanks all. Mark items done in the doc as you complete them and ping me if anything blocks. Closing loop here ":white_check_mark:"
